facts.value: 1250-1420 enrolled (70% submitted SAT; CDS 2025-26)
27-33 enrolled (44% submitted ACT; CDS 2025-26)
Average HS GPA 4.17 for enrolled first-years (CDS 2025-26). Admitted Class of 2030 middle 50%: core GPA 4.13-4.40, 9-14 AP/IB/DE courses, SAT 1360-1500, ACT 31-34. UGA recalculates a core-course GPA
Test-required (SAT or ACT); no test-optional pathway under University System of Georgia rules. Superscores both; scores must be requested by the application deadline
No; average 78% of need met for first-years, 491 of 1,798 with need fully met (CDS 2025-26 H2)
Not required; FAFSA for federal aid (Georgia state aid such as HOPE/Zell Miller applies separately)

Yes; most academic scholarships are awarded automatically from the admission application (finalized by early April). Out-of-state awards include Classic (half the out-of-state differential) and Classic City Scholars/One UGA/Presidential Leadership (full differential waiver). Foundation Fellowship needs a separate application by Nov 1
$18,079 (in-state, 2023-24); NCES net price covers in-state students only
2026-27 COA on campus: Georgia resident $29,920 (tuition $10,134 + fees $1,494); non-resident $52,156 (tuition $31,804 + fees $1,494)

Nonbinding EA Oct 15 (materials Oct 29; decisions before Dec 1 for Georgia residents, mid-December for others). Most EA applicants are deferred to RD. RD Jan 1 (materials Jan 15), final decisions mid-March. No ED
No admission interview; interview 'not considered' (CDS 2025-26 C7). One teacher recommendation optional but encouraged
Not considered
UGA does not limit admission by intended major; applicants pick one major (or undecided) and can change it before enrolling. Business, CS and engineering majors are listed as 'intended'
No UGA supplemental essay for Fall 2027: only the Common App personal essay (250-650 words) is required

EA applicants are automatically considered for the Morehead Honors College; others apply by Jan 15. Race, ethnicity and legacy are not considered. Valedictorians/salutatorians of accredited Georgia high schools are guaranteed admission if criteria are met

CDS figures were read from collegedata.fyi's copy of UGA's 2025-26 CDS; the official file (https://oir.uga.edu/wp-content/uploads/UGA_CDS_2025-2026.pdf) was fetched but its form values did not extract
